subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What first-run policy should OpenClaw use when Anthropic onboarding selects an Opus/API-billed model before terminal hatch?
rationale: Current main still applies the paid Opus default and lacks a pre-hatch credit/billing warning, but changing provider defaults or adding billing gates affects setup behavior, provider policy, and user expectations.

options.title: Warn or preflight before hatch
options.body: Keep Anthropic available as-is but add an explicit paid-credit/billing readiness warning or preflight before the first terminal chat, plus clearer billing failure copy if the account cannot run the model.

options.title: Change the Anthropic default
options.body: Move first-run Anthropic setup to a cheaper or safer default model and document how users intentionally opt into Opus.

options.title: Keep current policy
options.body: Leave Opus as the intentional default and treat the issue as docs/support wording instead of an in-product setup change.

recommendation.title: Warn or preflight before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep Anthropic available as-is but add an explicit paid-credit/billing readiness warning or preflight before the first terminal chat, plus clearer billing failure copy if the account cannot run the model.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest provenance ties steipete to the Anthropic default and setup wizard policy that this decision would change.
